title: Specora Signed Artifact Envelope — metadata.json v1.0
description: Normative JSON Schema for the metadata.json file that accompanies every Signed Artifact Envelope (Wire Spec v1.0 §2.8 and §4). The envelope itself is a directory layout; this schema covers only the metadata object, which is the machine-readable component.

key_fingerprint_sha256.description: Full SHA-256 hex digest of the raw Ed25519 public key bytes.

derived_key_id.description: Stable key identifier: 'spk-' prefix + first 16 hex chars of key_fingerprint_sha256.

signature_covers.description: v1.0 permits only 'manifest_hash_utf8' — the UTF-8 bytes of the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical payload bytes.

note.description: Optional free-form human note (e.g. 'test vector, private key not stored').
